item.title: Iran War Updates: Trump Puts Off ‘Final Determination’ on Iran Proposal
item.description: The president met with aides for two hours at the White House about a possible cease-fire extension, according to a senior administration official. Earlier, Mr. Trump had suggested in a social media post that he was ready to make a decision.

item.title: Middle east live: Pentagon chief says US 'more than capable' of restarting war with Iran
item.description: The US ⁠is 'more than capable' of restarting ​attacks on Iran if a deal cannot be reached, Defense Secretary ​Pete Hegseth said on Saturday, as negotiators from Washington and Tehran worked to bridge major differences blocking an agreement. The Pentagon chief said President Donald Trump was "patient" and wants to ensure ​Iran does not get a nuclear weapon. Follow our live blog for the latest updates.

item.title: Israel declares new 'combat zone' in southern Lebanon, orders evacuations
item.description: Israel expanded its military campaign in southern Lebanon on Wednesday, ordering residents to evacuate areas south of the Zahrani River as strikes intensified despite an April ceasefire. The escalation comes as Israeli officials seek to pressure Hezbollah while avoiding actions in Beirut that could complicate US-led diplomacy with Iran.

item.title: Israeli strikes kill dozens in southern Lebanon as Netanyahu expands ground campaign
item.description: Israeli strikes in southern Lebanon killed 31 people and wounded 40 on Tuesday, Lebanon’s health ministry said, including at least four children and three women, as Israel said it was intensifying operations despite a truce with the Iran-backed group Hezbollah.

item.title: After a brutal winter, Ukraine’s drones are breaking Russian defenses
item.description: Russia’s advance has suddenly stalled, and Ukraine is fighting on its own terms — a comeback credited to Kyiv’s efforts to steadily strengthen the capabilities of its UAVs.

item.title: Pentagon hosts first-ever Israeli–Lebanese military talks aimed at curbing Hezbollah
item.description: Israeli and Lebanese military delegations open U.S.-brokered talks at the Pentagon focused on ceasefire enforcement and border stability amid tensions.

item.title: Hamas struggles to fill leadership ranks as Israel hunts Oct 7 terrorists
item.description: Hours after an Israeli airstrike killed Hamas military wing chief Mohammed Odeh, Gaza's Eid markets were full, revealing a disconnect with Hamas.

item.title: Trump Board of Peace's official Gaza fund is empty despite billions pledged, source says
item.description: Four months after its creation, the Gaza reconstruction fund of US President Donald Trump's so-called Board of Peace has yet to receive any of the billions of dollars pledged by donor countries. Israel has continued to carry out strikes across the devastated Palestinian territory despite a US-backed ceasefire, killing at least 910 people since the truce was signed.
